newsitem.title: USA: Yellow cites listing change for activity.
newsitem.headline: Yellow cites listing change for activity.

text.p: Yellow Corp said on Friday the announcement that the company was no longer included in the Standard & Poor's 500 index might explain the heavy trading volume in its stock.
The transportation holding company said it was aware of no other development that could have led to the increased activity.
After the close of business on Friday, Yellow will be listed in the S&P SmallCap 600 Index.

"The S&P action has likely caused investors such as S&P 500 Index funds to sell our stock independent of the improved performance demonstrated in our recently released third-quarter results," said Bert Trucksess, senior vice president and chief financial officer.
Yellow shares closed 1-1/16 lower at 12 in regular Nasdaq trading on turnover of nearly 2.9 million shares, compared with average daily volume of about 194,000.
Yellow reported a profit in the third quarter of $8.9 million, or $0.32 per share, versus a net loss of $11.6 million, or $.41 per share, for the same quarter last year.
